title: Carl Sagan and the Golden Disc

tellings.quote: he was the one who helped put that Golden Disc together that's now in our extra solar system

plain: Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken publicly about UFOs, brings up the astronomer Carl Sagan when talking about contact with other worlds. Elizondo says Sagan helped put together the Golden Disc, a message from humanity sent out in the 1970s on a spacecraft that has now left our solar system.
